review_description: Based on initial quotes we decided that the payback did not justify the cost of a battery being approximately half the overall cost. We went through a number of system sizes before making a decision. We have a 3 phase supply and were frustrated with Ausnet's initial position that required an export limit on one phase which significantly restricted our expoort capacity. This was ultimately acceptably resolved with the assistance of our system supplier. This replaces a 5kW system installed in 2012
Thanks to your site I felt much more informed and comfortable in dealing with the 7 quotations I received.Thank you again.
Were not able to comply with the installation date initially provided.
